item.title: Pantograph 1.1.9
item.description:
New

  • Click a video to pause or play it. Clicking a video no longer jumps to the next file; it pauses or plays instead. The arrow keys still step through the videos in the folder.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.9.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
